Sandbox_JC_MaxSafehouseClaims_tooltip: Maximum number of safehouses a single player can own. (1-5)
Sandbox_JC_MaxVehicleClaims_tooltip: Maximum number of vehicles a single player can claim. (1-10)
Sandbox_JC_SafehouseExpirationDays_toolt: Safehouses are automatically released after this many real days of owner inactivity. Set to 0 to disable.
Sandbox_JC_VehicleExpirationDays_tooltip: Claimed vehicles are automatically released after this many real days without owner interaction. Set to 0 to disable.
Sandbox_JC_ClaimPaddingOptions_tooltip: Semicolon-separated list of padding values players can choose when claiming a safehouse. Example: 0;2;5;10 gives four options. Values are tile counts added around each side of the building footprint. Set to just 0 for no padding.
Sandbox_JC_ProtectSpawnRadius_tooltip: Prevents claiming buildings within this many tiles of a player spawn point. Set to 0 to disable spawn protection. (0-200)
Sandbox_JC_ResidentialRequireLivingroom_: Building must contain a living room to be considered residential. Only applies when SafehouseAllowNonResidential is false.
Sandbox_JC_ResidentialRequireKitchen_too: Building must contain a kitchen to be considered residential. Only applies when SafehouseAllowNonResidential is false.
Sandbox_JC_ResidentialRequireBedroom_too: Building must contain a bedroom to be considered residential. Only applies when SafehouseAllowNonResidential is false.
Sandbox_JC_ResidentialRequireBathroom_to: Building must contain a bathroom to be considered residential. Only applies when SafehouseAllowNonResidential is false.
Sandbox_JC_ResidentialMatchMode_tooltip: 1 = Must contain ALL checked room types. 2 = Must contain AT LEAST ONE checked room type.
Sandbox_JC_GarageProximityEnabled_toolti: When enabled, small garage and shed buildings (1-2 rooms) can be claimed if a residential building is nearby. Only applies when SafehouseAllowNonResidential is false.
Sandbox_JC_GarageProximity_tooltip: When SafehouseAllowNonResidential is false, small buildings (like garages) that fail the room type check can still be claimed if a residential building is within this many tiles. Set to 0 to disable. (0-30)
Sandbox_JC_CustomClaimEnabled_tooltip: Allow players to claim a predefined grid area for custom-built structures that PZ doesn't recognize as buildings. Claims cannot overlap existing buildings, roads, or other claims.
Sandbox_JC_CustomClaimSizes_tooltip: Available grid sizes for custom land claims, comma-separated. (e.g. 10,20,30,40)
Sandbox_JC_SafehouseKeysEnabled_tooltip: When enabled, claiming a building locks all doors and gives the player 2 safehouse keys. Players can lock/unlock doors from either side via context menu.
Sandbox_JC_VehicleKeyCraftEnabled_toolti: Allow players to craft vehicle keys from the right-click context menu. Requires tools (hacksaw, file set) and a steel bar quarter.
Sandbox_JC_VehicleKeyCraftMechanics_tool: Minimum Mechanics skill level required to craft a vehicle key. (0-10)
Sandbox_JC_VehicleKeyCraftElectrical_too: Minimum Electrical skill level required to craft a vehicle key. (0-10)
Sandbox_JC_TrailerAutoKey_tooltip: When enabled, claiming a trailer automatically gives the player a key for it. No skill or materials required.
Sandbox_JC_ReclaimCooldownDays_tooltip: Number of in-game days a player must wait between claiming safehouses. Set to -1 to use the vanilla SafehouseDaySurvivedToClaim setting. Set to 0 for no cooldown.
Sandbox_JC_AdminBypassCooldown_tooltip: Admins, moderators, and GMs can claim safehouses without waiting for the reclaim cooldown.
Sandbox_JC_RequireAddMemberConsent_toolt: When enabled, the target player must accept an in-game prompt before being added to a safehouse claim. The target must be online; the invite expires after 60 seconds. Admins always bypass this check and add members instantly.
Sandbox_JC_RespectPhunZones_tooltip: When enabled, players cannot claim safehouses inside zones tagged with the 'nosafehouse' property by the Phun Zones mod. Has no effect if Phun Zones is not installed. Lets server admins paint no-claim regions onto the map.
